_comment: Sweep budget for scripts/doc_cite_adjacency.py, opened 2026-09-01. Each key is a cite whose line does not land within +/-3 of any symbol its own sentence names. The gate is red on any failure NOT here AND on any key here that has stopped failing - a waiver may not outlive its rot. Burn this down; do not grow it. Baselining is the LAST resort: 47 of the 113 failures measured on 2026-09-01 were re-anchored by hand in the same commit, and only what could not be re-anchored mechanically is here. Not every entry is rot - the reason says which are the probe's own blind spots (paired cites, docstring ranges, table rows), and those are the rows to answer with a better rule rather than a new number.

waived.docs/agent-runtime-harness/01-system-arc: RE-ANCHORED in the 2026-09-01 sweep to the named symbol's definition. Still reported because the sentence's identifiers live in the module docstring, tens of lines above the def — the probe cannot see a correct cite whose subject is only named at the top of the file.
NOT MECHANICALLY RE-ANCHORABLE: the sentence names no symbol that pins a single line in this file, so any new number would be a guess. Fix by naming the symbol instead of the line.
